title: JClaw eval suite
description: A set of eval cases. One suite per file, named <id>.json. Edit suites in place — git holds the history, and each run records a content fingerprint so two runs scored by different suite content are never compared silently. JCLAW-875, JCLAW-883.

id.description: Suite identifier. Must match the filename.

requiredTools.description: Tools this suite needs granted to measure anything. Capture grants exactly these to the __evaltest__ agent before a sweep and revokes the rest, so a run is reproducible from the repository rather than depending on whatever was last clicked in the agent editor. Omit for suites whose cases are self-contained prompts. Never rewrites a non-__evaltest__ agent's configuration.

id.description: Case identifier, unique within the suite. Reports and regression comparisons key on it, so renaming a case discards its history.

input.description: The user turn sent to the agent.

rubric.description: One line stating what this case is testing and why it earns its place in the suite.

kind.description: Every kind is decidable without a model call. Model-judged checks land with the critic (JCLAW-836).

args.description: contains_all / not_contains_any: the substrings (case-insensitive). matches: one regex. tools_called_exactly: the complete set of tool names the turn may call, compared as a multiset — an empty array asserts no tool at all. tools_called_within: the tools the turn MAY call, none of them required — the 'or' form, for when a tool is optional because the harness already supplied what it would return. Tool assertions are allowlists on purpose: a denylist only catches rogue calls someone predicted. tool_args_include: one tool name, paired with a 'schema' holding the expected arguments. tool_result_includes: a tool name followed by one or more substrings its result must contain (case-insensitive) — arguments say what the agent asked for, only the result says what happened. Per-kind arity is enforced by EvalDatasetLoader; only tools_called_exactly permits an empty array.

schema.description: json_schema: the JSON Schema the response must satisfy — EvalScorer implements a documented subset (type, properties, required, items, enum, additionalProperties, description) and the loader rejects any other keyword rather than ignoring it. tool_args_include: NOT a JSON Schema but a literal subset of the arguments a call must have carried, so its keys are the tool's own parameter names and no schema vocabulary applies.

limit.description: max_llm_calls: the call budget for the case (JCLAW-833's efficiency NFR, measured via llm_call_count from JCLAW-882). states_turn_time: how many minutes the time the reply states may be from the recorded turn start, read in the recorded timezone (JF-298).
